summary: Lists the seven debugger commands: print (p), task.args[key]=value, task_vars[key]=value (needs update_task), update_task (u), redo (r), continue (c), and quit (q).
questions: What commands are available in the Ansible debugger?
How do I continue to the next task from the debugger?
What's the shortcut to re-run a task in the debugger?

answer_card.title: Debugger commands
answer_card.answer_md:
| Command | Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `print` | `p` | Print task info |
| `task.args[key] = value` | | Update module args |
| `task_vars[key] = value` | | Update task vars (then `update_task`) |
| `update_task` | `u` | Recreate task with updated vars |
| `redo` | `r` | Run the task again |
| `continue` | `c` | Continue with the next task |
| `quit` | `q` | Quit the debugger |
